outcome: Pro-inflammatory cytokine expression and secretion (IL-6, TNF-a)
cohort: Human foetal membranes and myometrium tissues, including leukocytes, obtained from non-labouring and labouring conditions.
finding: Human labour is associated with significantly higher hCAP18 protein expression in foetal membranes and myometrium, and hCAP18/LL-37 induces pro-inflammatory and pro-labour mediators via the MyD88/NF-kB pathway.
